faq.a: It's for capable people who second-guess themselves, struggle to speak up, feel like a fraud at work or keep putting off what matters. You don't need to be 'broken' to benefit.

faq.q: How does the 6-week confidence program work?
faq.a: You meet Ella 1:1 once a week for six weeks, practice a few small daily exercises from your workbook and get chat support between sessions.

faq.q: Is the confidence guide really free?
faq.a: Yes. Download the 8-page starter guide with no payment and no obligation.

faq.q: Is coaching the same as therapy?
faq.a: No. Coaching is forward-looking and practical. It isn't a replacement for therapy or medical care, and Ella will suggest other support if that would help you more.

faq.q: How do I know which package is right for me?
faq.a: Book a free 20-minute discovery call. Ella will listen to where you are and recommend the best fit.
